_comment: lodTris (per asset) overrides the LOD triangle targets (null = class budget) for models placed by the hundred in towns; ring picks the renderer LOD distance class. Assets processed into the game by art/blender/br/process_assets.mjs. Performance over quality (owner, 2026-11-03): budgets are LOD0 triangles; fit scales the model so the named extent equals metres (max = largest horizontal side, y = height). draws = most textured materials kept (the rest become one vertex-coloured draw); textureMB = GPU texture memory cap for LOD0 (halved per LOD); detailMaps = keep normal/roughness/AO maps (otherwise base colour only). Heavier alternatives that were skipped are listed under skipped with the reason. draws (per asset) caps the textured draws below the class's, for buildings whose fit-out adds coloured groups.
